note: LFT-03: the Manual's text (Gameplay §3.3; GDD §2.8, the Company's voice). The title lines, the Power, Fuel, Drum gear, cage and Starting entries and the footer are the design's sample page verbatim. Magneto, Drive belt, Brake shoes and Rope clamps are drafts in the Company's voice from the job table, awaiting sign-off. Each entry names the kind of place a part is kept, never where. UI-07 localises these.

strings.manual.title: MORROW MAIN COLLIERY. EMERGENCY WINDER.
strings.manual.subtitle: Instructions for Restoring to Service.
strings.manual.kept: To be kept at the Pit Bottom.
strings.manual.job.power.name: Power.
strings.manual.job.power.text: The supply is to be restored at the District Substation. Burnt links are to be cleared with cutters before fuse cartridges are fitted: three are required. The main switch is to be closed by two men, one holding the trip.
strings.manual.job.fuel.name: Fuel.
strings.manual.job.fuel.text: The tank is to be filled with paraffin: {cans}.
strings.manual.job.magneto.name: Magneto.
strings.manual.job.magneto.text: A failed magneto is to be replaced from the spares kept at the fitters' shops, and made fast with a spanner.
strings.manual.job.drive_belt.name: Drive belt.
strings.manual.job.drive_belt.text: A perished belt is to be replaced with leather belting from the haulage engine houses. The joint is to be riveted with a hammer.
strings.manual.job.brake_shoes.name: Brake shoes.
strings.manual.job.brake_shoes.text: Worn brake shoes are to be renewed from the stores: two are required, fitted with a spanner.
strings.manual.job.drum_gear.name: Drum gear.
strings.manual.job.drum_gear.text: A stripped drum gear is to be replaced from the spare kept at the deep workshops. Two men to carry.
strings.manual.job.free_cage.name: The cage.
strings.manual.job.free_cage.text: Should the cage stand fast in its guides, it is to be levered free with a bar.
strings.manual.job.rope_clamps.name: Rope clamps.
strings.manual.job.rope_clamps.text: The winding rope is to be secured with four clamps from the stores or the fitters' shops, tightened with a spanner.
strings.manual.job.start.name: Starting.
strings.manual.job.start.text: Prime. Crank to the top of the stroke and, at the shudder, open the throttle at once. Should the engine fire back, crank again. The clutch will not engage until the engine has run one full minute.
strings.manual.footer: The brake is released by the electric supply and by no other means. The Emergency Winder is good for ONE wind. All men are to be aboard before the cord is pulled. By Order, the Manager.
